text:
TEST: Rs. 1 debit + Rs. 1 credit → Balanced
Draft discard hua; koi voucher post nahin hua

Cash Payment: date, cash book, pay-to account, amount, narration. Cash account credit hota hai, selected expense/account debit. Posted mistake ko reversal se theek karein. Cash Received: cash-in-hand debit, source account credit. Bank Payment: bank book credit, expense/account debit. Bank Received: bank book debit, source credit. Journal Voucher cash/bank ke baghair adjustment; date, narration, account, debit, credit, particulars line-wise; total debit=total credit. Test: Rs 1 expense debit, Rs 1 sales credit par “Balanced” aur “Post journal” enabled; back to list kiya; koi voucher post nahi. Pending Approvals maker-checker queue mein wait karte vouchers ko approve/reject karti hai. Expenses petty cash/till: category, amount, cash/card/bank transfer, note/reference, GL mapping; cash expense open register shift mein post ho sakta hai. Register Shifts opening/closing, cash in/out aur counted-vs-expected cash; demo mein open shift nahi. Fiscal Compliance e-invoice status queued/filed/rejected/failed, retry/audit. Bank Reconciliation bank statement ko GL/bank book se match; farq adjust, phir finalize. Inter-branch Transfers cash/bank approval-send-receive-reconcile lifecycle.

name: subtitle-12
text: Receivable, payable, period aur assets — sab ka apna control

name: account-controls-body-0
text: Customer Ledgers / AR Aging: humein kitna aur kab se lena hai. Supplier Ledgers: vendor ko kitna dena hai. AP Adjustments: supplier debit/credit note.

name: account-controls-body-1
text: Open = posting chal sakti. Closed/Locked = nayi ya backdated posting rukti. Year-end result Retained Earnings mein jata hai; reopen reversal banata hai.

name: account-controls-body-2
text: Budget vs Actual: approved plan aur posted GL. Asset Register: cost, useful life, salvage, depreciation, disposal. Depreciation Run journal post karta hai.

Customer Ledgers / AR Aging show amounts customers owe and how long overdue, with drill-down. Supplier Ledgers show payable statements. AP Adjustments post balanced debit/credit notes with selected offset account. Fiscal Year & Periods states Open, Closed, Locked; closed/locked periods block new/backdated posts. Budgets target fiscal year/period, GL, optional branch and cost/profit centre; approved budget stays locked until audited unlock. Year-End Close validates, transfers net result to Retained Earnings, hard-locks periods; reopen creates linked reversal. Asset Categories map asset, accumulated depreciation, depreciation expense and disposal gain/loss GL accounts. Fixed Asset Register stores cost, useful life, salvage value, status, capitalization, depreciation history, disposal or write-off. Depreciation Runs preview/post period depreciation and GL journal; duplicate asset/period charge is prevented.

Source: signed-in demo screens and safe form checks at https://hms-demo.infraspine.com/ (review dated 14 November 2026). Generated images are illustrative artwork, not screenshots of the application.

IPD: hospital wards/rooms/beds must be configured first; admissions need authorized Hospital encounter, attending doctor and bed. Then transfers, observations, progress notes and discharge summary. Demo had no active ward/bed; occupancy 0/0. Lab: configure category, individual test/panel, code/name, shared billable service, specimen type, price, result type numeric/text. Orders come from authorized encounter and configured consent/emergency policy; results restricted/encrypted. Demo had no test catalog/order. Hospital Pharmacy verifies doctor prescription, selects branch stock batch, dispenses quantity and audits returns. FEFO = first expiry first out; use soonest-expiring lot first. Billing may be immediate payment or add to hospital bill; authorized pharmacy user can override per-dispense. No active prescription was present; no drug was dispensed. Lab results, clinical notes and pharmacy dispensing are restricted workflows.

Suggested initial setup sequence from the demo guide: (1) Company/industry, branch, store/warehouse, POS register, currency/tax. (2) Accounts Group, Chart, branch cash/bank/sales mapping, Revenue Accounts, fiscal periods. (3) Product groups/categories/UOM/brands/products/prices/per-store opening stock. (4) Supplier/customer masters and price books. (5) POS shift, receipt, cash account, draft SKU/barcode test then authorized post. (6) Hospital service categories/billable services; resolve/retry the 502 issue. (7) Doctors, departments, branches, rooms and OPD sessions; attach default consultation service. (8) Patient registration, Reception check-in, fee clearance, worklist test. (9) As needed lab categories/tests/specimens/consent-emergency policy; IPD wards/rooms/beds; pharmacy stock. (10) Authorized test encounter, lab result, pharmacy dispense, Patient Billing. (11) Reports, audit log, shift close, bank reconciliation, backup schedule and permission review. Test in a safe environment with synthetic data and separate proof from production data.

name: subtitle-25
text: In lafzon ko samajh lein to menus aur reports asan ho jate hain

name: draft-posted-definition
text: Draft / Held = abhi final nahin     •     Posted = stock/accounts/reports mein record ho chuka

name: end-message
text: Pehle setup. Phir draft check. Sirf authorized final button se post.

Glossary: SKU = product internal code; UOM = Unit of Measure (piece/box/kg/litre); Batch/Lot = same product stock grouped by cost and expiry; Reorder level = minimum quantity alert; MRN = Medical Record Number; OPD = outpatient visit without admission; IPD = inpatient ward/bed admission; FEFO = First Expiry First Out; AR/Receivable = customer amount owed to us; AP/Payable = amount we owe supplier; GL = General Ledger; Debit/Credit = double-entry sides whose journal totals should match. Posted = transaction finalized and recorded in stock/accounts/reporting. Draft/Held = not final; draft can be edited and held POS bill can be reopened. Void cancels an invoice; refund returns money; return can reintroduce item/credit depending on workflow. Check reason/audit trail for each. Closing summary: demo retail screens show navigation/forms; POS SKU lookup and change math were demonstrated as a draft; journal balance validation worked as a draft. Patient synthetic record was registered. Hospital end-to-end workflow could not be proved in this demo because there were no doctors/sessions and service save returned 502.
